note: Manifest for the Assignments page. Each assignment: subject, type (written | quiz | recitation | worksheet), title, desc, due (free text), and submission. submission.mode: 'none' (display only), 'coming-soon' (placeholder button), 'google-form' (set url), 'link' (set url). Recitation assignments may set 'passage' to deep-link the Quran reader (?s=SURAH&from=A&to=B).

items.title: Recite Ayat al-Kursi
items.desc: Record your recitation of Surah al-Baqarah 255 with tajweed. Practice with the reader first — the colors mark the rules.

items.title: Tajweed color rules — practice quiz
items.desc: Self-graded practice on what each tajweed color means. Scores stay on your device.

items.title: Level 1 vocabulary — sentences
items.desc: Write one sentence for each word in this month's vocab list. Handwritten or typed.

items.title: Letter forms practice sheet
items.desc: Printable worksheet: trace and write each letter in its four contextual forms.

items.title: Numbers 0–100 — practice quiz
items.desc: Self-graded matching of Arabic numerals and names.

items.title: This month's theme — reflection
items.desc: One paragraph on the current hijri month's theme, using at least three words from the month's vocabulary.

items.title: 99 Names — practice quiz
items.desc: Self-graded practice matching names, transliterations, and meanings.
